title: Autopilot onboarding result
description: What the onboarding agent writes to /work/.autopilot/result.json.

commands.description: The real shell command for each check that the repo supports. Each one runs at the workspace folder of the dev container, with no network. Leave out a check the repo cannot run.

notes.description: Short items that a person must check or fix before agents work on the repo, such as a missing linter or test setup, or a change you propose to an existing .devcontainer/.

environment.description: The dev container, as a person reads it in the pull request.

image.description: The base image of the dev container.

services.description: The compose services next to the dev container, such as postgres or redis.

install.description: The command that installs the dependencies (postCreateCommand), or none.

reason.description: Why this image and these services, from what the repo shows.

devcontainer_files.description: Only when the repo has no .devcontainer/: the full text of each file to write in .devcontainer/, by file name. It must have devcontainer.json.
